parameters.query:
INSERT INTO report_raw_ghl_social_posts (post_id, account_id, platform, type, status, summary, error_message, published_at, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, insights, payload_json, batch_id, loaded_at)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, $10::timestamptz, $11::timestamptz, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb, $14, $15::timestamptz
ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
  published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, insights = EXCLUDED.insights,
  payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json, loaded_at = NOW()

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, workflow: 'LT - GHL Daily Social Ingest', status: 'completed', postsProcessed: $input.all().filter(function(i) { return i.json.post_id; }).length } }];
